title: Romeo
desc: Arivu desires a real love connection but ends up with Leela, who marries him out of family obligation. However, despite their differences, he tries his best to win her over.

title: Ethir Neechal
desc: When a man's deception about his real name is revealed, he is compelled to join a marathon to prove himself to his lover.

title: Max
desc: Inspector Arjun arrests two men for crashing into the police station. Soon, he desperately rushes to clear his name as the two are found dead.

title: Nenjamundu Nermaiyundu Odu Raja
desc: Youngsters Shiva and Vicky earn a living making videos on a digital platform and prank Jeepakaran, a businessman. However, Jeepakaran asks them to work for him in return for money.

title: Madhagaja
desc: The wife of one of two rival dons sends her son to a distant land to shield him from their relentless feud. However, the son, raised as an orphan, eventually returns to the brutal world of violence.

title: Pathaan
desc: A Pakistani general hires a private terror outfit to conduct attacks in India while Pathaan, an Indian secret agent, is on a mission to form a special unit.

title: Parking
desc: A parking spot frays the relationship between two neighbours of different generations and world views. Soon, the two men find themselves in an escalating battle to have the space all to themselves.

title: Mynaa
desc: To avoid getting into an unwanted marriage, Mynaa escapes with her childhood love, Suruli, and plans to marry him. Along the way, they face many problems and fate has something drastic in store.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Athomugam
desc: Martin uses a tracking app on his wife Leena's mobile. However, their relationship begins to suffer when hidden truths come to light.

title: Shivam
desc: Shiva is a carefree lad who helps couples in love marry. Soon, he finds his own heart stolen, while being pursued by enemies determined to break them apart.

title: Killer
desc: In Vizag and Aruku, a series of murders unfold. Meanwhile, a couple unknowingly visits Aruku during their vacation, only for the woman to mysteriously disappear.

title: Vada Chennai
desc: A proficient carrom player sets foot in the world of crime and joins forces with local gangsters to settle their feuds. However, he decides to take them down when they plan to wipe out his locality.

title: Nerukadi
desc: An honest police officer comes across a criminal-turned-corrupt politician, who intends to become the new chief minister for his own vested interests.

title: Kaithi
desc: An ex-convict's fresh start to life is threatened by vengeful enemies, compelling him to confront the dangers for a chance at freedom.

title: Kuselan
desc: Two childhood friends lose touch over the years as one grows up to become a national figure while another makes a living out of barbering. Little do they know that a surprise reunion is on the cards.
